desc:
Welcome to « East Riyadh », an open-world game inspired by the lifestyle of the Kingdom, specifically the city of Riyadh, where you can experience the game your way and create your own story.

Get yourself a car and drive around the city, explore different places, own your own home, and live your day the way you want in a city full of life and excitement.

From the city’s streets and landmarks, and police stations, to shops, markets, and unique locations, there’s always something new to discover around every corner.

Enjoy the freedom to explore, realistic driving, and plenty of role-playing options that let you live out your own story.

🚧« The game is currently in Beta » – Stay tuned for major updates and improvements coming soon.

Created by Arab World Studios
